name: You My Work of Art
source:
New surroundings, new faces – and you know no one. To avoid feeling isolated, you decide to get to know Esteban, a quiet classmate you’d overlooked.

Slowly, he surprises you, and you start to wonder… can he be trusted?

[From [url=https://paralixh.itch.io/you-are-my-work-of-art]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
新环境、新面孔——而且你谁都不认识。为了避免感到孤立，你决定认识埃斯特班，一个你忽视的安静同学。

慢慢地，他让你感到惊讶，你开始怀疑……他可以信任吗？

[来自[url=https://paralixh.itch.io/you-are-my-work-of-art]Itch.io[/url]]
